decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission.

Reason: In order to comply with the provisions of Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans: 

Drawings: A2853-PL-001 Location Plan, A2853-PL -010 Block Plan, A2853-PL -020 Detailed Block Plan, A2853-PL -099 Existing Basement Plan, A2853-PL -100 Existing Ground Floor Plan, A2853-PL -101 Existing First Floor Plan, A2853-PL -102 Existing Second Floor Plan, A2853-PL -103 Existing Third Floor Plan, A2853-PL -104 Existing Roof Plan, A2853-PL -199 Proposed Basement Plan, A2853-PL -200 Rev A Proposed Ground Floor Plan, A2853-PL -201 Rev A Proposed First Floor Plan, A2853-PL -202 Proposed Second Floor Plan, A2853-PL -203 Proposed Third Floor Plan, A2853-PL -204 Proposed Roof Plan, A2853-PL -300 Rev A Existing Front Elevation, A2853-PL -301 Rev A Existing Rear Elevation, A2853-PL -302 Rev A Existing North Elevation, A2853-PL -303 Rev A Existing South Elevation, A2853-PL -350 Rev A Existing Section AA, A2853-PL -351 Rev A Existing Section BB, A2853-PL -352 Rev A Existing Section CC, A2853-PL -353 Existing Section DD, A2853-PL -400 Proposed Front Elevation, A2853-PL -401 Proposed Rear Elevation, A2853-PL -402 Proposed North Elevation, A2853-PL -403 Rev A Proposed South Elevation, A2853-PL -404 Proposed Rear Elevation, A2853-PL -500 Rev A Proposed Section AA, A2853-PL -501 Rev A Proposed Section BB, A2853-PL -502 Rev A Proposed Section CC, A2853-PL -503 Rev A Proposed Section DD, A2853-PL -504 Rev A Proposed Section DD.

Documents: A2853-PL-1000 Design Access and Heritage Statement, Rev II_WHL _Daylight Sunlight Assessment (EAL Consult), Noise and Vibration Approach, Wiener Holocaust Library (OR Consulting Engineers), Sustainable Design Approach, Wiener Holocaust Libr ar y (OR Consulting Engineers)

Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interest of proper planning.
Condition : 3 - All new external work shall be carried out in materials that resemble, as closely as possible, in colour and texture those of the existing building, unless otherwise specified in the approved application. 

Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area in accordance with the requirements of policy D1 and D2 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017.
description: Two-storey rear extension linked to closet wing of the existing building to form a new learning space at ground floor with a new gallery and roof terrace at first floor, and other minor works to existing building.
